meta.title: Cocoon-derived draft addresses as a mini coordinate system (feasibility test)
meta.source: branch_draft_v0.json from demo_cocoon_to_branch (agent-authored draft, NOT committed)
meta.theory_lock: generate≠commit; S3 CLOSED; draft addresses only; cocoons are unintentional coordinate systems
meta.purpose: Test whether cocoon-derived draft nodes function as shared addresses in the localization protocol: (a) do they attract stops at all, (b) do they discriminate cross-family items, (c) does the form-cue content of gloss matter (S27 lesson at draft granularity).
meta.ablation_note: gloss_nocues = same gloss with the enumerated surface cues removed (semantic description only). This is the S27-style ablation applied to draft addresses.
